def N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower :
    SmoothDirections
      (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε ×ˢ (Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ univ))
      (fun x : (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint =>
        coefficientFamily D S C i 0 0 x.2 (liftSectorParameter S C x.1))

theorem N01Properties.componentCoefficientScalarJet_mixed_bound
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (n s : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m j (hcell : Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells j)
      (i : Fin 3) a b, a + b ≤ s → ∀ p,
      p ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) →
      ∀ x ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε, ∀ v : Fin n → StateDirections S × ℝ,
      |mixedDerivative a b (hN.componentCoefficientScalarJet m j hcell i n x v) p| ≤
        B * T.H (T.sample j) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * T.E0 (T.sample j) ^ B *
          oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading) base (s + loss) x v

theorem _root_.ContinuousFlexibility.Statements.SmoothDirections.pointTower_eq_jointJet
    (J : SmoothDirections (U ×ˢ V) f) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (p : PolarPoint) (hp : p ∈ V) (K : SmoothDirections U (fun x => f (x, p)))
    (n : ℕ) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ U) (v : Fin n → E) :
    K.D n x v = J.D n (x, p) (fun i => (v i, 0))

theorem _root_.ContinuousFlexibility.Statements.SmoothDirections.jointJet_unit_bound_of_mixed_parameter_bounds
    {f : E × PolarPoint → ℝ} (J : SmoothDirections (U ×ˢ V) f)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hc : Convex ℝ (U ×ˢ V))
    (low high : Seminorm ℝ E) (r : ℕ) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (p : PolarPoint) (hp : p ∈ V) {C H : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hbound : ∀ k a b : ℕ, k + a + b ≤ r → ∀ u : Fin k → E,
      (∀ i, low (u i) ≤ 1) →
      |mixedDerivative a b (fun q => J.D k (x, q) (fun i => (u i, 0))) p| ≤
        C * (H + ∑ i : Fin k, high (u i)))
    (v : Fin r → E × PolarPoint)
    (hv : ∀ i, low (v i).1 ≤ 1 ∧ |(v i).2.1| ≤ 1 ∧ |(v i).2.2| ≤ 1) :
    |J.D r (x, p) v| ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ r * C * (H + ∑ i : Fin r, high (v i).1)

theorem UniformWeightedJointGrowth.mixed_parameter_oneHigh
    {ι : Type*} {V : ι → Set PolarPoint} {f : ι → E × PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {J : ∀ i, SmoothDirections (U ×ˢ V i) (f i)}
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} {W : ι → ℝ} {base loss : ℕ}
    (hJ : UniformWeightedJointGrowth p W J base loss)
    (hp : Monotone p) (hW : ∀ i, 1 ≤ W i)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hc : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (U ×ˢ V i))
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (n s : ℕ) :
    ∃ C Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ Q ∧
      ∀ i x, x ∈ U → p base x ≤ R → ∀ y ∈ V i, ∀ v : Fin n → E,
      ∀ a b : ℕ, a + b ≤ s →
        |mixedDerivative a b (fun q => (J i).D n (x, q) (fun j => (v j, 0))) y| ≤
          C * W i ^ Q * oneHighVariationWeight p base (s + (n + loss)) x v

theorem hasInterpolation_spatial_affine_rpow_bound
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (hp : Monotone p) (hIp : HasInterpolation p)
    (oldBase oldLoss : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, oldBase ≤ B ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R → ∀ N b : ℕ, b ≤ N → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E, ∀ v : Fin n → E, ∀ Q : ℝ,
        p B x ≤ R → (∀ i, p B (v i) ≤ 1) →
        p (N + B + 1) x ≤ Q → (∀ i, p (N + B + 1) (v i) ≤ Q) → 1 ≤ Q →
        1 + p (b + oldLoss) x + ∑ i, p (b + oldLoss) (v i) ≤
          C * Q ^ ((b : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) + 1))

theorem weightedJetBound_of_transport_recurrence
    {I : Type*} {W H Q : X → ℝ} {U : Set X} {denom : ℝ} (N : ℕ)
    (hW : ∀ x ∈ U, 1 ≤ W x) (hH : ∀ x ∈ U, 0 ≤ H x)
    (hQ : ∀ x ∈ U, 1 ≤ Q x) (hdenom : 0 < denom)
    (F : ℕ → I → X → ℝ) (degree : ℕ → I → ℕ) (charge : I → ℕ)
    (terms : ℕ → I → ℕ) (factors : ∀ a i, Fin (terms a i) → ℕ)
    (rank : ∀ a i t, Fin (factors a i t) → ℕ)
    (index : ∀ a i t, Fin (factors a i t) → I)
    (known : ∀ a i, Fin (terms a i) → X → ℝ)
    (knownDegree : ∀ a i, Fin (terms a i) → ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ a i t j, rank a i t j ≤ a)
    (hdegree : ∀ a i t,
      knownDegree a i t + ∑ j, degree (rank a i t j) (index a i t j) ≤ degree (a + 1) i)
    (hcharge : ∀ a i t, (∑ j, charge (index a i t j)) = charge i)
    (hzero : ∀ i, degree 0 i ≤ N →
      HasWeightedJetBound W H Q U denom (degree 0 i) (charge i) (F 0 i))
    (hknown : ∀ a i, degree (a + 1) i ≤ N → ∀ t,
      HasWeightedJetBound W H Q U denom (knownDegree a i t) 0 (known a i t))
    (hrecurrence : ∀ a i, degree (a + 1) i ≤ N → ∀ x ∈ U,
      |F (a + 1) i x| ≤ ∑ t : Fin (terms a i),
        |known a i t x| * ∏ j, |F (rank a i t j) (index a i t j) x|) :
    ∀ a i, degree a i ≤ N →
      HasWeightedJetBound W H Q U denom (degree a i) (charge i) (F a i)

lower_consequences: On the same closed Icc buffer, d_m=(lambda/2)*W_m^(-P)>0, a≥d_m, -c≥d_m and Delta=b^2-a*c≥d_m^2. Restrict to V_m.
The reference state belongs to the same state neighborhood, so a0,c0,Delta0 at the identical physical y obey the same lower.
sqrt Delta,sqrt Delta0≥d_m; their sum≥2*d_m. For WeightedJointPowers use lower (lambda/2)*W^-P for a, (lambda/2)^2*W^(-2P) for Delta, and the corresponding positive lower for the square-root sum.
same_witness_and_domain.scope_limit: No whole-component raw discriminant floor is asserted. It may approach zero at a true root.
same_witness_and_domain.label_rule: j_m, C.cell m and circle label m are distinct until a genuine index/containing-point comparison is supplied.

coefficient_increment_producer.target: Bound the genuine coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower, deterministically postcomposed by h_m^(-1), in UniformWeightedJointGrowth p W at original base',loss. This is a bound on the existing actual function/tower, not a new representative.
steps: At each physical q, use pointTower_eq_jointJet with the actual sectorCoefficientTower and combine componentCoefficientScalarJet_of_mem. This gives EqOn between the same joint J's pure-state jet and the actual local scalar jet on the open component.
Apply mixed-derivative congruence on that open set, then componentCoefficientScalarJet_mixed_bound. The scalar-pi tower141 is not substituted for a joint tower.

For total joint order r, take the finite parameter prefix k≤r and call the raw mixed bound with spatial cap r. Constants precede m,j,i,point,state and slots; high order r+loss and low base' remain fixed as stated.
Convert each sample E0^C to K(C)*W^P(C) before taking finite sums/maxima. W≥1 allows exponent enlargement; an arbitrary original E0 has not been assumed ≥1.

Use the unit-direction one-high-to-affine inequality. In the first MixedJointTameBounds public theorem put C=h_m*A_r*W_m^P_r and H=1+p(r+loss)z. Its 3^r factor multiplies the entire h_m; the theorem's H is the affine state term, not the material height.
Use smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose and its exact apply formula for u↦h_m^(-1)*u. Cancel h_m>0 at every joint order, including zero. Do not estimate h_m^(-1) by an E0 power.
The normalized actual increment has UniformWeightedJointGrowth p W at base',loss. Restriction preserves J.D; uniqueness transfers to any already supplied tower of that same literal function.

sample_conversion.formula: Let x_j be the actual endpoint coordinate, |x_j-cellIndex j|≤L and E0(sample j)≤KE*materialE0(x_j). For R≥0 choose K,P uniformly in j with materialE0(x_j)^R≤K*materialE0(cellIndex j)^P. Then E0(sample j)^R≤KE^R*K*exp(P)*W_j^P.
sample_conversion.reference: Use the same hN'.IsRadialReference projection to IsAccumulatingProfile with hT; no unrelated retained Morse certificate is required for this comparison.

coefficient_increment_producer.nonuse: The second MixedJointTameBounds wrapper requires C uniform in labels and returns component exponent zero. Do not fit this route by absorbing H/E0 into a label-dependent C.

Freeze the same original towers at state zero via the continuous linear map (z,y)↦(0,y), with 0∈U and the defining value of liftSectorParameter at zero. Directly insert zero state slots in the actual bound. This yields the same a0,b0,c0, with no new reference choice.

Use minusCharacteristicSpeed_strip_joint_growth for the same actual original-speed tower and its state-zero restriction to obtain v0, or use the same finite a0,b0,c0 expression.

Combine the normalized increments with those multipliers via WeightedJointProducts.mul, WeightedJointOperations.prodMk/sub/postLinear/mono and WeightedJointPowers.inv. There are finitely many operations independent of derivative order, so resulting base/loss are fixed before all orders.

fixed_base_radial_budget.public_supplier: Statements.hasInterpolation_spatial_affine_rpow_bound, the first public theorem of CircleUniformAngularInterpolation
fixed_base_radial_budget.actual_input_contract: For a fixed finite list of genuine primitive types t, beta_t is fixed before parameter order n, and delta_t(n) precedes all physical orders. An input jet of physical order d uses high index d+delta_t(n). Preserve each separate height charge.
before_all_k: D0=max_t delta_t(0), including each actual type's fixed angular evaluation/derivative shift
Apply hasInterpolation_spatial_affine_rpow_bound(p,hp,hI,oldBase,D0) once. Its B precedes every k,s,label,state,point.
after_k_before_s: c_k=Finset.sup over t and 1≤n≤k of Nat.sub(delta_t(n),D0); empty k=0 supremum is 0
M=s+k*c_k; denominator=M+1; high=M+B+1; Q=1+p(high)z+p(high)w for diagonal slots
factor_budget: For parameter order n≤k and physical order d, set b'=d+Nat.sub(delta_t(n),D0). Then b'+D0≥d+delta_t(n).
If n=0 then b'=d. If n≥1 then Nat.sub(delta_t(n),D0)≤c_k≤n*c_k, hence b'≤d+n*c_k.
Monotonicity and the public interpolation theorem at (N,b,n)=(M,b',n) bound the affine factor by C*Q^(b'/(M+1)); the low B is unchanged.
For each actual Leibniz product prove sum n_i≤k and sum d_i≤s. Then sum b'_i≤M, so the total Q exponent≤M/(M+1)≤1. Constants may depend on k,s and the finite expression, but not the low B.
The final high s+(k*c_k+B+1) gives a loss chosen after k and before all s.
fixed_base_radial_budget.physical_degree_check: A_r=v_theta*A-v*A_theta spends an actual +1 physical degree on v or A; Z_r=-T*Z_theta spends +1 on Z. G in e_r has one fewer radial derivative than the target. Cutoff jets are state-independent W-cost factors, so their high-parameter degree is zero while their true physical derivative order remains paid in the separate cutoff constant.

scalar_kernel.last_step: After the diagonal estimate, use the actual mixedParameterMultilinearMap plus polarization/unit normalization with the same seminorms. Do not change the representative or choose a new low base for each spatial order.

actual_outer_supplier.exact_definition:
def OrdinaryFlowFamilyTameBounds (T : MaterialData) (S : PhysicalSpacesData)
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (base loss : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ parameterLoss : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m a b p,
    a + b ≤ s → p.1 ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) →
    ∃ J : SmoothDirections (stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (ordinaryFlowFamily S C m a b p),
      ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, ∀ v : Fin k → (AnnularState S × ℝ),
        min (p.1 - C.left m) (C.right m - p.1) ^ a * |J.D k z v| ≤
          B * T.H (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
          T.E0 (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ B *
          oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
            base (s + loss + parameterLoss) (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) v
actual_outer_supplier.role: A genuine clause of the same N01 witness. It retains H(sample(C.cell m))^(3/4) and min-distance^a on the whole open component. It supplies actual ordinary forward-flow differences, not every inverse/travel/gauge field.

exterior_and_sample_obligations.remaining_outer_work: Use actual cutoff constant germs and original-flow/endpoint identities off the supported transition, retaining the distance weight or proving genuine root-model cancellation. A uniform raw discriminant floor for a whole negative half is not supplied.
exterior_and_sample_obligations.sample_alignment: Display actual containing-point/index hypotheses before mixing circle label m, C.cell m and retained host j_m. material_actualCells_index_bound, radialE_rpow_of_nat_sub_bound and materialSample_H_E0_rpow_of_index_sub_bound transfer powers while retaining gamma=3/4. No identity among these labels is assumed.
exterior_and_sample_obligations.final_scope: Whole-region gluing, coordinate composition and actual canonical scaling remain CurrentJets assembly obligations after buffer forcing and radial induction.
